title: agentbox wire protocol
description: Item kinds agentbox accepts and the Result a blocking call returns (FR42). Items are sent over agentbox.v1.notify (notify) or agentbox.v1.ask (everything else); the daemon assigns id.

level.description: Severity. Omitted defaults to info. urgent escalates and breaks through DND.

action.description: A button on a notify item (FR32). Clicking it runs exec locally in the item's cwd; the command is shown verbatim on hover.

id.description: assigned by the daemon; callers leave empty

timeout_s.description: seconds until default/timeout; for veto it is the countdown window and must be > 0

strict.description: disable the free-text reply hatch on choice/confirm

sink.description: secret items: file the daemon writes the value to (mode 0600)

stdout.description: secret items: also return the value to the caller (opt-in)

actions.description: notify items: up to 3 buttons that run a local command on click (FR32)

cwd.description: notify items with actions: working directory the daemon runs an action's exec in

diff.description: diff items: the unified diff to review (FR33)

result.description: Returned by a blocking call. When answered is true, exactly one of answer, reply or values is set.

reply.description: the user typed free text instead of choosing (reply hatch)

values.description: form field values keyed by field key

default_applied.description: true when a timeout delivered the default

vetoed.description: veto items: true if the user stopped the action

secret.description: secret items with stdout opt-in: the value (never logged or stored)

secret_path.description: secret items: file the value was written to (mode 0600)

approved.description: diff items (FR33): the reviewer approved; reply carries any comment
